lines.t: I'm breathing in the silence of the room
Searching for a light inside the gloom
The waves are pulling at my feet again
Trying to remember where I've been
Yeah, I'm drifting, no compass in my hand
Building my house on the sinking sand
Shadows whisper, it's too late for grace
But I see a flicker of your holy face
In the static, in the noise
You're the only voice
My fingers are slipping, I'm losing the fight
But the sky is breaking with a holy light
I'm reaching out, yeah
You are the breath when I am breathless
The light when I am blind
In the middle of the ocean
You're the only one I find
Oh, pull me up, pull me up
Break the fear and kill the doubt
You're my lifeline
You're my lifeline
My steady hand in the rushing tide
Wait, look at the sky, the colors are changing
Everything broken, you're rearranging
It's not by my power, it's not by my might
You stepped in the water and finished the fight
No longer a captive, no longer a slave
You walked on the water, I'm out of the grave
Higher, take me higher
Out of the ashes, out of the fire
Your love is the rope, your word is the light
You are the breath when I am breathless
The light when I am blind
You're my lifeline
You are the breath when I am breathless
The light when I am blind
You're my lifeline

Lifeline
